run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the largest subsequence with GCD greater than 1 from an array
test_f_gold: test f_gold against sample arrays to verify largest GCD subsequence calculation
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which counts elements divisible by each candidate divisor from 2 to max
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to optimize the nested loop approach for finding largest GCD subsequence
review_f_gold: review f_gold algorithm that iterates divisors and counts divisible array elements
